name: Animal familiarity
description: An animal (like your cat or dog) is linked to your senses. If the animal senses danger you are notified of it. You can also tell the animal to go to places you know of.

name: Attention sink
description: People who don't know you forget how you look after meeting you for the first time as soon as you are gone.

name: Blessed ancestor
description: One of your dead ancestors, a powerful and well-known person, watches over the bloodline. Once a month you can reroll a failed roll.

name: Blood memory
description: You can contact dead ancestors in dreams and ask them questions.

name: Blood temper
description: Your family has an inherited temper. You gain 2 steps in strength but have disadvantage against taunts and intimidations in social battles.

name: Born stretched
description: Your family is known for their long arms. You add one reach to all weapons.

name: Clockless blood
description: Your body heals randomly. When you are healing from wounds roll a d6; a 1 means healing takes four times as long, a 6 that you heal four times as fast.

name: Compressed frame
description: Your family has a stout body with short torsos and strong bones. Gain 2 stamina steps.

name: Curing touch
description: Once per week you can remove a disease on an actor with a roll of your Faith vs 2d6.

name: Curse tongue, major
description: When in extreme stress your words can induce a random major Power-curse on someone else.

name: Curse tongue, minor
description: When in extreme stress your words can induce a random minor Power-curse on someone else.

name: Dark blooded
description: Your blood is dark red, almost black. Once a day you get advantage on a magic check.

name: Demonic favor
description: You have gained a favor from a supernatural being — once ever you can call it in and turn a missed roll into a success.

name: Demonic sympathy
description: Supernatural beings feel familiar with you. You get advantage on summoning and disadvantage on banishing.

name: Dream prophecy
description: Sometimes (at the GM's decision) you receive prophetic dreams that cryptically describe possible future events.

name: Dream walking
description: You can travel through your dreams to places you have visited before. Once per night at the cost of one less stamina point for the full day.

name: False blessing
description: Once a day you can add a Multiplier die to an attack roll. For the next 10 turns you must add an extra Risk die.

name: Grave-marked
description: You have foggy breath at much higher temperatures than others. You have advantage on battles vs revenants.

name: Healing touch
description: You can once a day heal 1d6-2 hit points by laying your hand on yourself or someone else. Negative results hurt the target instead of healing.

name: Incorrupt
description: Your body ages half as fast as normal people. Your apparent age is half your factual age.

name: Inherited authority
description: Your family has an inherited authority that gives advantage in social battles with subjects of lower social status.

name: Light bones
description: Your family is recognized by its slender and flexible bodies. Add 2 steps in Dexterity.

name: Lingering presence
description: A supernatural being has noticed you and follows you. You constantly feel watched. The entity has an agenda — advantage when you align with it, disadvantage when you oppose.

name: Lucky star
description: You have advantage on one roll per day.

name: Marked flesh
description: Your family has a recurring mark that identifies it. An oddly shaped birthmark, an extra nipple, or something else.

name: Memory anchor
description: Your memory has improved. You can always roll an Intelligence check vs 2d6 to remember things you have forgotten in play.

name: Miraculous
description: Once a month you can attempt to perform a miracle (resurrection, healing of a plague victim, etc.). The GM decides the result and impact. Always accompanied by a miracle tell (object/body/light/smell/animal/weather influence — roll d6 and let the player choose flavor).

name: Miraculous survivor
description: Once ever you can miraculously survive what would have killed you.

name: Moment slip
description: You have a knack for avoiding attention. Once a week you can avoid a situation that the GM rules acceptable — pickpocket escape, slipping past angry villagers, etc.

name: Name lore
description: You have developed a good pronunciation of true names and get advantage on all rituals involving one.

name: Night rider
description: You can use the Night Rider spell once per day.

name: Omen Sense
description: You have an acute understanding of omens and get a chance to avoid ambushes and traps due to your sensitivity to omens.

name: Resilient blood
description: Your body heals twice as fast as others.

name: Royal touch
description: Your bloodline has royal inheritance and you can perform the royal touch to cure consumption.

name: Sacred resilience
description: Your asceticism gives you the power to avoid revealing secrets during torture, and gives an extra stamina point.

name: Second sight
description: You can get glimpses of the future at the GM's choice. A few of the glimpses are false.

name: Shadow walker
description: You have developed a phenomenal ability to blend into shadows. You gain advantage on all your stealth rolls.

name: Spirit recognition
description: You can identify supernatural causes of diseases and curses and find the identity (not the true name) of the spirit causing it.

name: Spirit vision
description: You can see spirits.

name: Translucent skin
description: Your family is characterized by semi-translucent skin — veins visible. This also gives advantage on disease checks.

name: Unquiet Lineage
description: An ancestor is talking to you in your dreams. Once a month an ancestor may demand something. Advantage when you align with the ancestor's agenda, disadvantage when you oppose. The effect stops when the demand is met until a new one is given.

name: Veiled insight
description: You know things you shouldn't know about. You gain advantage on investigation rolls.

name: Voices of temptation
description: You sometimes hear voices during prayer that give hints or mislead you.

name: Weight of sin
description: You can concentrate and try to detect an aura (Faith vs Charisma) around people living a violent or immoral life.

name: Aura of invitation
description: You radiate an invitation to supernatural beings, and wards against them cannot protect you.

name: Beast blood
description: Your family is endowed with excessive hair growth. Without extensive grooming it is a tell of your heritage.

name: Blighting
description: Milk turns sour and bread refuses to rise in your presence.

name: Cold iron discomfort
description: You have a slight discomfort with cold iron. Your skin gets temporary marks when in contact with cold iron.

name: Cold iron sensitivity
description: You take double damage when hit with weapons made of cold iron.

name: Corpse pallor
description: Your skin has the complexion of a corpse, hindering you in social interactions.

name: Corrupted
description: When stressed the bearer gets a dark temptation that they must follow.

name: Devil's restlessness
description: You are constantly restless and your motions jerky, giving disadvantage on any subterfuge skill.

name: Dread
description: You are constantly afraid and feel watched. You must spend a Faith point before entering a battle.

name: Dream tongue
description: Every night you speak in your sleep — in a foreign tongue.

name: Fate bound
description: Your presence is bound to fate. The GM decides one specific event you cannot avoid when faced with it.

name: Failing flesh
description: You lose one step in Strength, Dexterity, and Stamina.

name: Flickering
description: Candles flicker when you enter a room.

name: Hollow hunger
description: You need twice as much food per day.

name: Ill luck
description: You start all fights with a Risk die.

name: Inherited Madness
description: Your family is plagued by an inherited madness that shows under stress.

name: Living Omen
description: Omens follow you. When you arrive at new places you are accompanied by an omen — birth of a two-headed cow, ravens roosting on a building, or similar. The omen raises the fear of the citizens.

name: Occult signature
description: Your occult presence is strong and you show up unintentionally in divinations in the area.

name: Nightbound
description: You dislike sunlight and start all daytime battles with an extra Risk die. In very strong sunlight (GM decides) all your attacks have an extra Risk die.

name: Nightmares
description: Your dreams are uneasy and troubling. Stamina, Strength, and Dexterity are each reduced by one.

name: Ritual scars
description: Your body produces large scars each time you use a ritual. The scars are visible for a month after the ritual.

name: Ritual tic
description: Your dabbling in rituals has given you an obsessive tic chosen by the player.

name: Sanctified aversion
description: You feel uneasy in churches and other religious areas and get disadvantage on all rolls at such a location.

name: Sanctified sickness
description: You cannot enter churches and other religious areas — you take damage and get disadvantage on all rolls there.

name: Self sacrificial
description: Your faith is bound to a specific cause (injustice, suffering, devotion to your religion). Every time you face a challenge to your cause you must act unless you succeed on a Faith roll vs 3d6.

name: Soul leakage
description: Your soul is not totally contained in your body, giving disadvantage on defense vs spirits.

name: Spiritual doubt
description: You have gained doubt in your faith. All rolls involving faith are made with disadvantage.

name: Tainted ancestor
description: Someone in your family line did a great evil. The reputation gives disadvantage in social battles with opponents who know.

name: Temporal Echo
description: Others tend to have memories with you that never occurred.

name: Truth aversion
description: You feel uneasy telling the truth. All social battles that are truthful are done at disadvantage. Lying is fine.

name: Unhealing wounds
description: Your wounds heal badly. Every wound after an hour's onset incapacitates you for 1d6 hours.

name: Witches' mark
description: You have been marked by the occult — a visible blemish, deformity, or scar. People who know witch marks will recognize it.

name: Withering
description: You slowly wither away. Each year you lose one hit point permanently.

name: Evil Eye
description: A necromantic power granted by Pagan Expertise: Necromancy. Fix a malignant gaze on a target within 5 squares as a ranged strike costing 1 Core Point. Resolve Power vs Power: on a win it inflicts 1 Soul damage multiplied by one multiplier die per rank of Necromancy, and no armor can turn it aside. A single blank multiplier face wastes the strike. Prayer Against the Evil Eye — and some warding charms — grant immunity for a day.

name: Evil Eye (Innate)
description: An innate malevolent gaze borne by spirits, undead, and unnatural things — no Necromancy skill required. Fix it on a target within 5 squares as a ranged strike costing 1 Core Point. Resolve Power vs Power: on a win it inflicts 1 Soul damage multiplied by one multiplier die per point of the creature’s Power, and no armor can turn it aside. A single blank multiplier face wastes the strike. Prayer Against the Evil Eye and warding charms grant immunity for a day.
